text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season has 
arrived once again. Last year, she was 
right in the middle of the Classic Triple 
Crown campaign, but now she walks a path 
meant for King Halo alone.

Around that time, Special Week asks which 
race they'll enter next. However, the 
conversation is interrupted, and the two 
promise to talk again later.

Is it precisely because they walked 
different paths that new realizations and 
passions were born? —Regardless, they are 
rivals through and through.
